Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform took longer to certify than expected, and that certification process has pushed our schedule back by two weeks. The new delivery date is 14 April.

Our team has been working closely with the certifying body to move things along as quickly as possible, and we're confident this timeline is now solid. All other workstreams remain on track, and this delay does not affect the scope or quality of what we're delivering. We'll continue to monitor the certification closely and will flag immediately if anything changes.

Does 14 April still work well with your internal planning, or are there any milestones on your end we should factor in? In the meantime, please don't hesitate to reach out with any questions, and we'll keep you posted on progress as we approach the new date.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
